info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Hotel Rooms Amenities-v2-spec
info.description: The Hotel Room Amenities API provides access to detailed information about the amenities available in hotel rooms. This API enables users, such as hotel staff and booking platforms, to efficiently retrieve comprehensive lists of amenities for various room types. Consumers can utilize this data to enhance the guest experience by clearly displaying available features during the booking process. The API supports queries for both individual amenities and groups, streamlining the integration of amenities data into customer-facing applications.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of amenities available for rooms.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the amenities associated with various rooms. Use this endpoint to understand what additional services or features are offered in each room type, enhancing the guest experience.
